summary: 10 countries today, with US coverage spread across tech, trade, immigration, diplomacy, courts, culture, sport and society. The Iran talks and a new tariff and sanctions push run through the political news, but they share the page with Meta's AI spending, a critical minerals deal, World Cup football, a fresh ambassador in Seoul and polling on how the world now sees America.
